quarterly_data.signal: AstraZeneca opened its newest global strategic R&D centre, The AstraZeneca R&D Center Kendall Square at 290 Binney Street, Cambridge, Massachusetts: a 570,000 square foot, 18 story site with ten floors of interconnecting laboratories integrating robotics, continuous automation and agentic AI. Together with its genomic-medicine site at 100 Binney Street it will house nearly 2,000 researchers and scientists working on the oncology, cell therapy, chronic disease and rare disease pipeline. As part of its broader US investment of $50 billion, AstraZeneca is investing more than $1 billion in Massachusetts, which the company says will expand its workforce in the state by over 50% in the coming years. It is the company's second US global strategic research centre after Gaithersburg, Maryland; AstraZeneca has 24 US R&D, manufacturing, commercial and corporate sites, a US workforce of more than 25,000 people and R&D presence in more than 40 countries.
